user_question: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate total population and land area by census tract across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve tract land-area table
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a candidate tabular dataset containing tract identifiers and land-area values for Centre County.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a candidate CSV table with census-tract-level land-area values covering Centre County. Treat the result as a candidate and validate its coverage and schema at runtime.

workflow_steps.title: Join population table to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach total population attributes from the known ACS table to the known Centre County census tract polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an attribute join between the known vector artifact and the known CSV table. Leave vector_key and table_key unset so runtime schema QC can ground the compatible tract identifier fields.

workflow_steps.title: Join land area to population-enriched tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach tract-level land-area values to the census tract polygons already enriched with total population.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an attribute join between the population-enriched tract vector and the retrieved land-area table. Leave vector_key and table_key unset so runtime schema QC can ground the compatible tract identifier fields.

requirements.scope: The retrieved land-area table must represent census tracts covering Centre County.
The retrieved land-area table must contain a tract identifier field and a land-area field suitable for joining and reporting.
The final tract layer must contain fields representing census tract identity, total population, and land area.

agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.

skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.
